target_condition: Tomato Mosaic Virus (ToMV) & Tobacco Mosaic Virus (TMV)
pathogen_scientific_name: Tomato mosaic virus / Tobacco mosaic virus (Tobamovirus)
conferred_phenotype: Durable dominant immunity preventing systemic viral movement and leaf mosaic/necrosis symptoms.
environmental_interaction: Stable across wide greenhouse temperature ranges (20-32°C); durable against field resistance breakdown.

conferred_phenotype: Suppresses viral replication and symptom severity through enhanced cytosine methylation and siRNA viral gene silencing.
environmental_interaction: Vector pressure (Bemisia tabaci whiteflies) at temperatures >28°C increases inoculation load; heterozygous Ty-1/ty-1 shows mild symptoms under extreme whitefly pressure.

pathogen_scientific_name: Fusarium oxysporum f. sp. lycopersici race 2
conferred_phenotype: Monogenic dominant resistance preventing xylem vessel colonization and vascular browning/wilting.
environmental_interaction: Soil temperatures between 25-28°C highly favor Fusarium infection in susceptible plants; resistant plants maintain vascular integrity.

conferred_phenotype: Cell surface LRR-receptor recognition of Ave1 effector; induces PR gene expression and prevents vascular wilt.
environmental_interaction: Disease manifestation is elevated in cool soils (20-24°C) with moist conditions.

conferred_phenotype: Rapid hypersensitive response (HR) and local cell death restricting bacterial multiplication in stomata and apoplast.
environmental_interaction: Prolonged leaf wetness (>90% humidity) and cool temperatures (18-24°C) trigger severe bacterial speck outbreaks in susceptible crops.

conferred_phenotype: Strong broad-spectrum foliar and fruit protection against multiple aggressive Phytophthora infestans lineages (US-22, US-23, T30-4).
environmental_interaction: Extreme disease risk under high relative humidity (>85%) and moderate temperatures (15-22°C). Ph-3 markedly dampens sporangial sporulation.

conferred_phenotype: Immune recognition of viral movement protein NSm triggering systemic protection and preventing lethal necrotic collapse.
environmental_interaction: Thrips feeding behavior at 24-30°C governs vector transmission; Sw-5b remains robust across typical temperate/tropical greenhouse climates.

conferred_phenotype: Receptor-mediated recognition of Avr9 elicitor protein triggering localized hypersensitive necrotic flecking and fungal arrest.
environmental_interaction: Leaf mold proliferates rapidly in greenhouse environments with relative humidity >80% and poor air ventilation.

conferred_phenotype: Recessive loss of susceptibility factor preventing fungal appressorium penetration through papilla formation.
environmental_interaction: Powdery mildew thrives in moderate temperature (20-25°C) and moderate relative humidity (60-80%); mutant ol-2 plants show total immunity.

conferred_phenotype: Localized cell death at nematode feeding sites preventing giant cell formation and galling; repels aphid stylet probing.
environmental_interaction: CRITICAL: Mi-1.2 resistance breaks down and becomes ineffective at soil/ambient temperatures above 28°C (82.4°F).

conferred_phenotype: Eliminates green shoulder in ripening fruit producing uniform color; lowers chloroplast abundance and reduces final sugars/carotenoids by 15-20%.
environmental_interaction: Solar radiation and temperature influence fruit ripening uniformity and color development.
